description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget class called 'BoardTile', representing an interactive, animated square tile for a Tic Tac Toe game's board. The widget displays 'X' or 'O' with visual accents, provides tap feedback with scale animation, rounded corners, elevation effects, and can highlight itself for winning indication.

classes.description: A Flutter widget that displays a square tile with animated tap effects for the Tic Tac Toe game.
